FIFA World Cup Round of 32 Matches Conclude

Several matches in the FIFA World Cup Round of 32 have concluded, featuring prominent teams like Germany, Netherlands, Morocco, Brazil, and Japan. Germany was eliminated by Paraguay in a penalty shootout after a disallowed goal, while Brazil advanced by scoring late against Japan. Netherlands and Morocco also faced off in a Round of 32 clash.
